title: 第9章 玩命修仙七天引气入体第10章 喜提储物袋又交保护费
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
光影扭曲，林渊的身影再次出现在酒店房间。
他甚至没顾得上喘口气，第一时间冲出房门。
在最近的24小时便利店里，他将货架上所有口味的压缩饼干和真空包装的牛肉干，扫荡一空。
回到修真界，他直接找到赵升，将沉甸甸的背包丢了过去。
“赵师兄，老规矩。”
林渊的声音沙哑，连续几天的精神高度集中，让他看起来有些憔悴，但那双眼睛却亮得惊人。
“我准备闭关，争取早日引气入体！”
赵升看着那满满一包花花绿绿的“乾元饼”，眼冒精光。
他深知这些东西在外门的价值，这可都是实打实的资源。
他郑重地点了点头，没多废话，转身就去处理这批“货物”。
林渊则反锁房门，开启了他疯狂的修炼之旅。
他再次吞下一颗聚气散。
腹中那股熟悉的暖流炸开，他驾轻就熟地引导着药力，心神沉入对天地灵气的感应之中。
整个世界在他的感知里，彻底变了样。
如果说昨夜的灵气还只是拂面的微风，那么此刻，嗑了药的他感觉自己就像站在了风暴眼，周围全是呼啸的灵气狂风。
灵犀之境，在丹药的催化下，正以前所未有的速度加深。
他想起赵升所说，要等到感觉灵气浓郁如水，如臂使指，才能一鼓作气，将其引入体内。
他能感觉到，丝丝缕缕的灵气被牵引着，涌入他的经脉。
但它们就像一群调皮的过客，在他体内游走一圈，便不受控制地逸散出去，根本无法沉淀下来，化为己用。
纯粹的浪费。

林渊却并不气馁，他能清晰地感觉到，每一次灵气的冲刷，都在对他的经脉进行着一次微不可查的洗礼和拓宽。
到了晚上，赵升敲响了他的房门。
“林师弟，成了！”
赵升递过来一个装着10颗聚气散的小瓷瓶，脸上是藏不住的喜色。
“一共换了二十颗聚气散，给陈天平师兄那边送了七颗，我留了三颗当跑腿费。”
“这是你的十颗。”
林渊接过沉甸甸的布袋，只道了声谢。
有了这十颗聚气散，他冲击境界的底气，更足了。
接下来的一周，林渊的生活陷入了一种疯狂的自虐循环。
他不再计算时间，只是不眠不休地修炼，直到胸口的玉佩颜色开始转红，被强制传送回地球。
在地球短暂的停留时间里，他用最快的速度冲进超市补货，将压缩饼干与肉脯塞满身上每一个口袋，然后再次返回修真界，继续这枯燥而玩命的修炼。
只有实在困了，他才会在地球休息一会儿。
就这样，聚气散的消耗速度越来越快。
从一开始的一天两颗，到后来的一天三颗，甚至四颗。
只要前一颗的药力耗尽，他便吞下下一颗，用丹药强行维持着那种灵气充盈的状态。
终于，在第七天的傍晚，当他再次吞下一颗聚气散后，他感觉到经脉中的一股灵气，在完成了九次周天运转后，竟出现了将要质变的迹象！
时机到了！
他偷偷看了一眼胸口的玉佩，还是稳定的绿色，距离强制穿越还早。
林渊眼神一凝，透出决然。
他拿出了自己身上最后的底牌——那枚从外事堂领来的下品灵石。

他将灵石紧紧握在掌心，一股冰凉而精纯的能量顺着掌心劳宫穴，源源不断地渗入体内。
与此同时，他再次吞下一颗聚气散。
content_en:
The light and shadow were distorted, and Lin Yuan's figure appeared in the hotel room again.
He didn't even take a breath and rushed out of the room immediately.
At the nearest 24-hour convenience store, he cleared the shelves of all flavors of compressed biscuits and vacuum-packed beef jerky.
Returning to the world of cultivation, he directly found Zhao Sheng and threw the heavy backpack over.
"Senior Brother Zhao, the old rules."
Lin Yuan's voice was hoarse, and he looked a little haggard due to his high concentration for several days, but his eyes were astonishingly bright.
"I'm going to retreat and try to get Qi into my body as soon as possible!"
Zhao Sheng's eyes lit up as he looked at the bag full of colorful "Qianyuan cakes".
He knows the value of these things at the outer door, and they are all real resources.
He nodded solemnly, turned around and went to deal with this batch of "goods" without saying anything else.
Lin Yuan locked the door and started his crazy cultivation journey.
He swallowed another Qi Gathering Powder.
The familiar warm current in his belly exploded. He guided the medicine's power with ease, and his mind sank into sensing the aura of heaven and earth.
The whole world has completely changed in his perception.
If the spiritual energy last night was just the breeze blowing on his face, then at this moment, after taking drugs, he felt like he was standing in the eye of a storm, surrounded by the howling spiritual energy wind.
The realm of consonance, catalyzed by the elixir, is deepening at an unprecedented speed.
He remembered what Zhao Sheng said, that he had to wait until he felt the spiritual energy was as thick as water, like an arm and his fingers, before he could introduce it into his body in one go.
He could feel the strands of spiritual energy being pulled into his meridians.
But they were like a group of naughty passers-by, wandering around in his body and then dissipating uncontrollably, unable to settle down and be used for his own purposes.
Pure waste.
Lin Yuan was not discouraged. He could clearly feel that every wash of spiritual energy was baptizing and broadening his meridians in a subtle way.
At night, Zhao Sheng knocked on his door.
"Junior Brother Lin, it's done!"
Zhao Sheng handed over a small porcelain bottle containing 10 Qi Gathering Powders, with a look of joy on his face.
"I exchanged a total of twenty Qi Gathering Powders, and gave seven to Senior Brother Chen Tianping. I kept three as errand fees."
"Here are your ten."
Lin Yuan took the heavy bag and just said thank you.
With these ten Qi Gathering Powders, he has more confidence to attack the realm.
Over the next week, Lin Yuan's life fell into a crazy cycle of self-abuse.
He no longer counted time, but practiced sleeplessly until the color of the jade pendant on his chest began to turn red, and he was forcibly transported back to Earth.
During his short stay on earth, he rushed into the supermarket as quickly as possible to replenish supplies, stuffed every pocket on his body with compressed biscuits and dried meat, and then returned to the world of cultivation again to continue this boring and life-defying practice.
Only when he is really sleepy will he rest on the earth for a while.
In this way, the Qi Gathering Powder is consumed faster and faster.
From two pills a day at the beginning, to three pills a day, or even four pills a day.
As soon as the power of the previous one was exhausted, he would swallow the next one and use the elixir to forcibly maintain the state of full spiritual energy.
Finally, on the evening of the seventh day, when he swallowed another Qi Gathering Powder, he felt a spiritual energy in his meridians. After completing nine cycles, there were signs of a qualitative change!
The time has come!
He secretly glanced at the jade pendant on his chest. It was still a stable green, and it was still early for him to be forced to travel through time.
Lin Yuan's eyes condensed, showing determination.
He took out his last trump card - the low-grade spiritual stone he received from the Foreign Affairs Hall.
He held the spirit stone tightly in his palm, and a cold and pure energy flowed into his body along the Laogong point in his palm.
At the same time, he swallowed another Qi Gathering Powder.
